title: Low degree junta polynomial work bound
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. Write $r=|\{i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}:i\notin P\}|$, $\ell=k-\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, $m$ for the prescribed polynomial-learning sample count, and $D$ for the number of subsets of an $r$-element set having size at most $\ell$. The work bound is $m(D+1)+Dm(D+2)+D(D+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
